infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Vela reads body weight, body fat percentage, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, steps and VO₂ max from Apple Health so your physiotherapist can see how training is affecting your recovery. Your health data is never used for advertising and is never shared with third parties.
